meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
India mein ₹3000 ke budget mein running shoes ke liye kayi behtareen options available hain, jo beginner runners aur daily joggers ke liye perfect hain.

Yahan top 4 running shoes ki list di gayi hai jo is budget mein value for money aur accha comfort dete hain:

---

### Best Running Shoes Under ₹3000 (India)

| Brand & Model | Approx. Price (INR) | Key Features / Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Campus OXYPRO / FIRST** | ₹1,500 - ₹2,300 | Light weight, breathable mesh, great daily wear and beginner running. |
| **Asian Nitro-01 / Wonder-13** | ₹1,000 - ₹1,800 | High cushioning at an affordable price, durable outsole. |
| **Red Tape Sports Running Shoes** | ₹1,200 - ₹2,500 | Stylish look, comfortable sole, good grip for morning walks and light jogs. |
| **Sparx SX0325G / Running Range** | ₹1,200 - ₹2,000 | Highly durable, sturdy build quality, great arch support for Indian roads. |

---

### 💡 Tips for Buying Running Shoes Online/Offline:

* **Size Up:** Running shoes kharidte waqt hamesha apne normal shoe size se **ek size bada (1 size up)** lein (jaise agar aapka size UK 8 hai toh UK 9 lein), kyunki दौड़te waqt pair thode phoolte hain aur aage jagah honi chahiye.
* **Usage:** Agar aap sirf **walking ya light jogging** ke liye chahte hain toh Sparx ya Campus best rahenge. Agar aap **regular running (5km+):** karna chahte hain, toh koshish karein ki thoda cushioning wala model select karein.
